shots.label: Talking head, medium
shots.quote: Yeah. I'm a shark, in a puffer jacket.
shots.beat: Medium shot in the green study. The shark turns ==three quarters to camera== and the jaw opens on every syllable.

shots.label: Talking head, medium
shots.quote: And Claude edited this entire video.
shots.beat: Hold the medium. On ==Claude== a prompt bar drops in above the dorsal fin and types the instruction.

shots.label: Push to close
shots.beat: Camera springs in to a close-up; the grin fills the lower third. ==No captions== over the mouth.

shots.label: Close, hold
shots.beat: Hold on the close, a slow drift right; the end card types in on ==hand==.
